system.description: You are incapable of human speech, whether because your jaw has collapsed or you've been abandoned in the sewers too long. You may use sign language, write out what you want to say, or communicate through grunting and wild gestures, but you can never utter a word in character (the only exception is nonverbal communication with animals). You may talk to your Storyteller or Narrator for rules purposes, but in-game you must roleplay the Flaw at all times.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
